Brief-claimed-by: session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb · batch #401 · 2026-10-26T15:42Z

Director seat, summon #51 continuation (ledger objectstack#12708). Presented to the maintainer in batch #401 as item 1 of 5 (with #26149, batch #400's open item, re-presented beside it at the maintainer's word 「按照总监决裁格式详细写」). Seat increment (re-verified on `origin/main` `cdd4eea9`; the card's own analysis is not restated):
- Premises hold: no `typesVersions` in any `packages/*/package.json` (0 files); the published docs already tell plugin authors `moduleResolution: "bundler"` (`content/docs/plugins/development.mdx:46`); PR #26198 (the attw run that produced the finding) is open.
- Human floor: 对外承诺 — which consumer setups the published packages support — so the letter is the maintainer's. The card has no facets block; the seat's reading on the four axes: ① one declaration of each subpath (`exports`) stays the only one — a `typesVersions` mirror is a second copy that drifts and needs its own gate (④ 新增门禁默认否); ② no consumer has reported a node10 miss; TypeScript 5 projects and this repository's own templates resolve with `bundler` / `node16`; ③ a documented refusal is loud (the consumer reads one sentence), a mirror that drifts is silent; ④ A adds nothing.
- Facets read: same direction; the seat agrees with **A** (one docs paragraph plus a README line per affected package: node10 unsupported, use node16 / nodenext / bundler). Workload: devx · 1 docs PR, no governed path.
Prior rulings read: `typesVersions` · `moduleResolution` · `node10` → the docs line only; ADR none; thread: none.

Ruling: batch #401 item 2 · letter A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-26T17:25Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). The maintainer answered batch #401 with 「同意」 — every seat letter. Brief 6420278132. Letter **A**: TypeScript's legacy `node10` module resolution is declared unsupported for the published `@objectstack/*` packages — consumers use `moduleResolution: node16`, `nodenext` or `bundler` (the shape `content/docs/plugins/development.mdx:46` already shows). One docs paragraph (the consumer setup page) plus one line in each of the 15 affected packages' README; no `typesVersions` mirror, no new check (④ 新增门禁默认否; one declaration of each subpath stays the only one). Not B.

Workload of the chosen letter (card column): devx · 1 docs PR, no governed path.

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act (`domain:devx`, p3). `Ruling-ref:` names this comment; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. The PR cites the attw reading on PR #26198 (report 6419735271) as its evidence.
